Subject: Certification lifecycle questions + evidence zoning for ISO27001 / FedRAMP intake

Hi Sara / Acme security team —

Thanks again for the intake call yesterday. Per our discussion, I wanted to capture a concise set of questions so we can align evidence handoff windows and owners on the Redwood side. We're trying to avoid duplicate asks across SIG/CAIQ and the ISO/FedRAMP mapping work.

High-level asks:
- Can you confirm whether Acme needs all ISO27001 controls scoped to the service boundary, or only a subset for dataflow components that touch customer data? (we've seen both approaches)
- For FedRAMP readiness, do you expect snapshot evidence for the full 30-day retention window, or are sampled extracts acceptable during a pre-audit dry run?
- Is there an approved template for the SIG/CAIQ responses that you prefer? We have an intake PDF but want to make sure formats match your tooling.

Proposed delivery plan from Redwood:
1) Share current evidence matrix (attached: evidence-matrix-v0.3.xlsx) with column for FedRAMP/ISO/SIG mapping and suggested owner.
2) Owner confirmation & minimal sample extraction (week of 2026-08-24).
3) Full snapshot / dry-run artifacts (two week window starting 2026-09-07) if required.

Practical questions for your intake:
- Which control sets must be live for the dry run vs. final audit?
- Any specific artifact naming or redaction guidance for attorney-reviewed logs?
- Preferred secure delivery channel (SFTP, ephemeral Drive link, vendor portal)?

Attachments: evidence-matrix-v0.3.xlsx (worksheet: mapping), control-owner-map.csv (simple owner list)

Thanks — looking to get owners plugged in today so we can trigger the control-owner confirmations on Redwood's side.

Best,
Mateo

Subject: Re: Certification lifecycle questions + evidence zoning for ISO27001 / FedRAMP intake

Thanks, Mateo — this is great and very clear. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

1) Scope: For Acme Bank we'll need ISO controls assessed only for the service boundary components that process cardholder or account data. We don't require org-wide ISO scope for this engagement. Please mark those resources in your mapping (network segments, KMS/HSM, tokenization microservice).

2) FedRAMP dry run: Sample extracts are acceptable for the dry run, but for the full readiness assessment we'll require a 30-day log snapshot for syslog and application audit trails. Start with 7-day samples for initial review.

3) SIG/CAIQ format: We use the questionnaire JSON import in our vendor portal (CSV is fine if you also send the JSON). The intake PDF you sent is OK as a guide; please also export answers as machine-readable JSON if possible.

Secure delivery: SFTP is preferred for artifacts containing raw logs; ephemeral Drive links are OK for PDFs and spreadsheets.

Can you confirm whether the evidence matrix includes a suggested retention policy column? That would help speed reviewer triage.

We'll loop Paul (auditor) for sequencing — he can advise on sampling approach for control families.

Best,
Sara
Sara Kim
Vendor Risk Manager | Acme Bank
